portion_doctrine: Segments 31-40 of 'world_building_characters_etc.docx' are entirely video transcripts (tutorial/demo content) covering AI + 3D creative workflows: Claude AI + Blender MCP integration, procedural generation systems for 3D modeling, Adobe Express integrations, SketchUp automation, and video production automation workflows using Higgsfield image generation. No strategic frameworks, operating principles, business methodology, or world-building content found. This is instructional/technical documentation of tool usage patterns, not foundational SNIPED corpus material.
operating_rules: MCP server startup sequence: Open Claude Desktop first, then Blender, then start the MCP server in Blender's side panel
Blender add-on installation: Edit > Preferences > Add-ons > Install from Disk (addon.py)
UV package required for Blender MCP integration (install via Homebrew on Mac, direct installer on Windows)
Claude config file edit path: Top right menu > Files > Settings > Developer tab > Edit config

Metadata attachment to Blender objects enables semantic understanding: create JSON metadata for object properties
Procedural agent workflow: pre-made assets + metadata + agent instructions = puzzle assembly without from-scratch generation
Video editing timestamp-based workflow: image filenames must match exact timestamps (0.07 = 7 seconds) for automatic sync
prompts: Create me a simple wave animation, very smooth, cartoonish. He raises his hand, he waves, he puts it back down.
Design me a shoe for a track runner living in New York City and competing in a marathon that represents my competitive spirit

Translate all object names in this Blender scene from Chinese to English
Rename these Blender objects to represent corresponding shoe parts (e.g., laces, upper, sole) based on position and dimension analysis
Change the part I have selected to a metallic gold color
Create a JSON file for each shoe part and connect it to object data properties as metadata
Take our existing lighting setup, organize it into its own collection, duplicate it three times, and create variations based on different emotions or moods
Refine the lighting to affect the HDRI and create a Python plugin panel so I can easily switch between different HDRI lighting setups
Generate images matching this video script with exact timestamps for each frame
